en.text: Hi! I keep your suits running: the armor here, and the skills next door. Your suit does a lot more than keep the air in.
en.description: A young woman in her early twenties, the suit technician of a mining ship, born on an orbital station and on her first trip away from it, talking to a crew member in the armor room. Bright, light voice, quick and cheerful, eager and open, a little fast when she's excited. Natural and genuine, not childish, not cute, not breathy or seductive. Plain and conversational. Native English speaker with a neutral accent.

de.text: Hi! Ich halte eure Anzüge in Schuss: die Panzerung hier und die Fähigkeiten nebenan. Dein Anzug kann viel mehr, als nur die Luft drinnen zu halten.
